title: CO/BTN open facing a blind 3-bet
keyIdea: Blinds 3-bet wide against late opens, and you have position. Defend a lot: pairs, suited aces, suited broadways and connectors.

actions.call: JJ-44, AJs-A8s, KQs-K9s, QJs-Q9s, J9s+, T9s, 98s, 87s, 76s, AQo-AJo, KQo-KJo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
